title: Disclose the supported models first
when: Before agreeing to governance for an existing database
need: Current validator supports SQLite/local validation and Postgres/external validation, both with Python governed migration modules. MySQL and external-adapter runners are explicitly unsupported. A Postgres model requires only database_name; optional stack/output coordinates must be non-empty strings when present. Every environment database runs on its box; db-admin setup uses the declared database and provisioned DSN file.
surface: Migration model pairing matrix and capability validator.
gap: Surface these limits before collecting credentials or implying Alembic/Prisma/other migration frameworks can be adopted unchanged. Unsupported is not incomplete install.
